headline: Security researchers turned AI coding assistants into an attack surface as Japan's KDDI disclosed a breach exposing 12 million people and decades-old Linux kernel code again handed attackers root.

emerging_trends.text: Researchers keep aiming attacks at the AI coding assistants developers now trust, and HalluSquatting—registering the package names an assistant reliably invents—shows how one made-up dependency can seed a botnet across nine popular tools.
emerging_trends.topic_title: AI Coding Assistants Turned Into an Attack Surface

emerging_trends.text: Attackers have moved past stuffing stolen credentials to social-engineering the login's final step, phoning Microsoft 365 users and coaxing them to enroll a rogue Entra passkey that sails past multifactor prompts.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Entra Passkey Enrollment Vishing Hits Microsoft 365

emerging_trends.text: Decades-old kernel code keeps yielding fresh root, as the GhostLock flaw traces to 2011 and Google paid $250,000 for a related guest-VM escape disclosed the same week.
emerging_trends.topic_title: GhostLock and a $250,000 Linux VM Escape

topics.title: AI Coding Assistants Turned Into an Attack Surface
topics.latest_developments: Researchers on July 8 unveiled HalluSquatting, which maps the fake package names AI coding assistants reliably hallucinate, registers them first, and lets nine popular tools fetch botnet malware onto users' machines, while Abhishek Kumar and Carsten Maple showed GitHub Copilot refuses a harmful request in chat yet writes the same exploit when a user breaks it into small steps, and Sophos found agents including Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenAI Codex tripping endpoint rules built to catch human intruders.
topics.summary: AI coding assistants both invent nonexistent dependencies attackers can preregister and generate dangerous code that chat filters would block, exposing developers who run their output. Pin dependencies, review generated code, and tune endpoint detections to distinguish agent behavior from intrusions.

sources.title: New HalluSquatting Attack Could Trick AI Coding Assistants Into Installing Botnet Malware
Hackers can use 9 of the most popular AI tools to assemble massive botnets
GitHub Copilot Refuses Harmful Requests in Chat, Then Writes Them in Code
AI Coding Agents Found Triggering Endpoint Security Rules Built to Catch Attackers

topics.title: KDDI Breach Exposes 12 Million, Accenture Confirms Source-Code Theft
topics.latest_developments: Japanese telecommunications giant KDDI said July 8 that attackers breached an email platform serving five domestic internet service providers and exposed the email addresses and passwords of more than 12 million people, the same week Accenture confirmed a threat actor using the handle 888 stole 35 GB of source code, RSA and SSH keys, and Azure access tokens it advertised on the PwnForums cybercrime forum.
topics.summary: The KDDI incident spilled credentials for over 12 million subscribers across five Japanese ISPs, while Accenture's stolen secrets could seed follow-on cloud intrusions. Affected users should reset passwords and enable multifactor authentication; Accenture says it contained the incident with no service impact.

sources.title: Telco giant KDDI says data breach affects over 12 million people
Accenture Confirms Data Breach After Hacker Claims Source Code Theft
Accenture acknowledges security incident following 35GB data theft claim

topics.title: China-Linked Espionage Spans Taiwan, Universities, and US Water
topics.latest_developments: Taiwan prosecutors charged two businessmen on July 8 for running a company that leased LINE messaging accounts to Chinese spies, BleepingComputer detailed a China-linked cluster exploiting Roundcube webmail flaws to steal credentials and plant backdoors at U.S. and Canadian universities, and Wired reported insurers war-gaming a mass Volt Typhoon strike on U.S. water utilities that yielded burst mains and evacuated hospitals.
topics.summary: Chinese state-aligned operations are surfacing across messaging-app fronts in Taiwan, academic webmail espionage in North America, and simulated sabotage of critical U.S. water infrastructure. Patch Roundcube servers, scrutinize third-party account leasing, and harden operational-technology networks against pre-positioning.

sources.title: Taiwan charges two businessmen over alleged role in Chinese espionage campaign
Hackers exploit Roundcube flaw to spy on academic researchers
What Happens if China Hacks the US Water Supply? I Went to a Secret War Game to Find Out

topics.title: GhostLock and a $250,000 Linux VM Escape
topics.latest_developments: Ars Technica reported July 8 that Google paid a $250,000 bounty for a high-severity guest virtual-machine escape, one of two Linux root flaws surfacing this week alongside GhostLock (CVE-2026-43499), the 15-year-old kernel bug Nebula Security disclosed that gives any logged-in user full root and container escape on essentially every mainstream distribution shipped since 2011.
topics.summary: Two unrelated Linux flaws—a guest-to-host VM escape and the long-dormant GhostLock privilege-escalation bug—both let untrusted users reach root with no special settings. Administrators should apply distribution kernel updates immediately given the breadth of exposure.

sources.title: Google pays $250k for Linux vulnerability allowing guest VM escapes
15-Year-Old GhostLock Flaw Enables Root and Container Escape on Most Linux Distros

topics.title: Vidar Infostealer Hits SMBs Through Malvertising
topics.latest_developments: Dark Reading and Palo Alto Networks' Unit 42 detailed on July 7 and 8 a financially motivated Vidar campaign that lures small and midsize businesses with cracked and pirated software, then pairs credential and data theft with XMRig cryptomining, hiding its loader through DLL sideloading of a Go-compiled fake MpClient.dll and code-signing abuse.
topics.summary: The operation delivers a two-for-one payload—Vidar stealer plus a cryptominer—via malvertising and trojanized software downloads aimed at SMBs. Block pirated-software downloads, monitor for anomalous DLL loads, and watch for unexpected mining activity.

sources.title: Vidar Infostealer Hammers SMBs via Malvertising Campaign
Vidar Stealer Unmasked: Code Signing Abuse, Go Loaders and File Inflation

topics.title: Entra Passkey Enrollment Vishing Hits Microsoft 365
topics.latest_developments: BleepingComputer reported July 8 that a threat actor is phoning Microsoft 365 users across multiple sectors with fake security requests urging them to enroll a new Entra passkey, a move that quietly hands the attacker a persistent login, as The Hacker News framed the account-takeover fight shifting to the verification step now that passkeys have gone mainstream and credential stuffing has faded.
topics.summary: Attackers now call employees directly and coach them through registering an attacker-controlled Entra passkey, defeating multifactor prompts and yielding durable Microsoft 365 access. Restrict passkey enrollment, verify identity out of band, and train staff to distrust unsolicited security calls.

sources.title: Entra passkey enrollment vishing targets Microsoft 365 users
The Verification Step Is the New ATO Battleground in 2026

business_politics.title: UniCredit Wins Voting Control of Commerzbank
business_politics.latest_developments: UniCredit said it likely secured voting control of Commerzbank shares after lifting its stake to just under 50% in its open tender, moving past the nearly 48% reported a day earlier.
business_politics.summary: Andrea Orcel's UniCredit, the Milan-based lender, engineered an end run around German political resistance to take effective control of Frankfurt's Commerzbank, creating one of Europe's largest banking groups.

sources.title: How Andrea Orcel Did an End Run Around Germany to Build a Banking Giant

business_politics.title: Fed Minutes Show Officials Split on Inflation
business_politics.latest_developments: Minutes released July 8 from last month's meeting showed the rate-setting committee deeply divided, with some officials arguing for future rate rises to contain inflation as the Iran War winds down.
business_politics.summary: The Federal Reserve held its benchmark rate unchanged at last month's meeting, and the newly published minutes reveal policymakers split over whether price pressures will cool or stay elevated, leaving the path of U.S. rates uncertain for banks and markets.

sources.title: Some Fed officials saw need for future rate rises to contain inflation

business_politics.title: Trump Says Iran Ceasefire Is Over
business_politics.latest_developments: A day after declaring the ceasefire finished, Trump said the latest exchange of fire does not herald a return to full-scale war even as he threatened fresh strikes, and oil pulled further from pre-war levels while U.S. crude stockpiles posted their first build in eleven weeks.
business_politics.summary: President Trump declared his ceasefire with Tehran over and threatened more strikes and a naval blockade following Iran's tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz, keeping oil and safe-haven flows on edge.

sources.title: Trump Says Ceasefire With Iran Is Over After Latest Attacks

around_town.title: Parkway East Closure Gets Its Own Website
around_town.latest_developments: The Shapiro administration launched a dedicated 511PA website to route drivers around the 25-day Parkway East closure, which starts at 9 p.m. July 10.
around_town.summary: PennDOT will shut the Parkway East (Interstate 376) between the Squirrel Hill Tunnel and the Edgewood/Swissvale exit for 25 days while crews demolish the old Commercial Street Bridge and slide a new span into place, disrupting a route that carries roughly 100,000 vehicles a day.

around_town.title: EQT Seeks Fracking Permit Near Elizabeth Township School
around_town.latest_developments: EQT is asking Elizabeth Township's approval to drill its six-well Heracles operation near a school, a second and potentially final attempt after a three-year legal fight.
around_town.summary: The Pittsburgh gas producer EQT wants Elizabeth Township, Allegheny County, to permit fracked wells close to a school, reigniting a three-year battle that has pitted the company and township commissioners against local environmental advocates and worried residents.

sources.title: EQT wants Elizabeth Township's approval for fracked wells near a school. Residents are worried.

around_town.latest_developments: Residents packed a Monroeville Citizen Night to argue over the removal of a Pride display from the Monroeville Public Library.
around_town.summary: The removal of an LGBTQ Pride display from the Monroeville Public Library drew a crowd to a borough meeting in Monroeville, Allegheny County, where the dispute became a local flashpoint in the national culture-war debate over LGBTQ equality.

sources.title: Monroeville turns out in force to spar over library's Pride display removal
